## Change

F1. Disable unchecked multi-choice boxes at Worker-provided maximum, leaving selected boxes enabled for deselection. Mirrors existing field-reducer bound; Worker remains legality authority.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN captured. Parent reviewed multiple-choice branch and regression, reran 1 focused + 19 related component tests; real Chromium production-component harness passed 1 test.
V2. Worker typecheck, targeted lint/format, boundary/data-cy: 87 and diff checks passed.

## Limits

L1. Isolated production-component browser proof, not full application bootstrap. No recovery-marker bypass. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
